name: coptolex
description: CoptoLex — Comprehensive Coptic Lexicon by Copto.org, powered by Cloudflare Pages and D1 SQLite

scripts.build: npm run build:widget && python scripts/generate_sitemap.py && tsc && vite build
scripts.deploy: npm run build && wrangler pages deploy dist --branch=main --commit-dirty=true
scripts.data:sync: npm run data:build && npm run data:deploy
scripts.upstream:deploy: python scripts/sync_upstream.py --sync --branch upstream-sync && npm run data:deploy
